## What

Receive the assembled boards and bring them up carefully:

1. Power rails one at a time from a **current-limited supply**.
2. MCU boots.
3. SOM boots Linux over UART.
4. JTAG works.

Keep a rework log from the first power-on.

## Done when

- [ ] All rails in tolerance (measured values recorded).
- [ ] Linux boots on the carrier.
- [ ] Rework log started in `hardware/bringup/`.
